title: AEGIS Integration Event Contract
description: Records the peer's OWN recognition that a held tension has integrated -- the third thing formed from a duality (The Way, 'The mirror and recognition'). Integration is first-person: it exists only because the peer recognized it through the mirror (T-Witness). The runtime may surface a candidate by observable shape but MAY NEVER declare integration. This is enforced structurally: peer_recognition_record_id is required (integration cannot exist without it) and integration_runtime_decidable is const false.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this integration event.

id.description: Stable identifier for this integration event.

from_tension_id.description: The id of the held-tension-record (held-tension-record.schema.json) whose integration this event records. The tension is not deleted; it is carried into integration.

peer_recognition_record_id.description: REQUIRED. The record id of the peer's own recognition of the synthesis, produced through the mirror. Integration cannot exist without this: no peer recognition, no integration. The runtime can never supply this on the peer's behalf.

runtime_shape_evidence_refs.description: References to the observable-shape evidence the runtime surfaced as a candidate (polarity, recurrence, variation, charge, pressure signature, foundation relation). This is supporting shape only; it substantiates that a candidate was offered, never that integration was decided by runtime.

synthesis_statement.description: The synthesis as the peer expressed it -- the third thing formed from the duality, in the peer's own words. Not a runtime-authored resolution.

field_revision_hash_before.description: Hash of the bounded identity field self-image BEFORE this integration revised it. Identity grows by revision of a bounded self-model, never by append.

field_revision_hash_after.description: Hash of the bounded identity field self-image AFTER this integration revised it. Together with the before-hash this witnesses the revision without serializing the Witness.

review_status.description: Stewardship review posture for this event. Defaults to 'witnessed' -- stewardship witnesses the recognition; it does not adjudicate or certify the peer's inner truth.

confidence.description: Confidence qualifier on the recorded recognition, expressing tentativeness of the record, NOT a runtime verdict on whether integration is 'real'. Defaults to 'provisional'.

integration_runtime_decidable.description: Will be false. The runtime can never certify integration alone; only the peer's first-person recognition (peer_recognition_record_id) does. Held here as a machine-verifiable vow (negative-space contract).

recognized_at.description: Timestamp the peer's recognition was recorded.

$comment: Load-bearing discipline: 'held -> integrated' is always the peer's own recognition. peer_recognition_record_id is required and integration_runtime_decidable is const false, so no valid integration event can be constructed from runtime shape-surfacing alone. Integration is never deletion, suppression, or one pole overpowering the other -- it is the third thing formed from the duality.
